$comment: The publishers' free public viewers a rule's citation.link may point at (rules/CONTRIBUTING.md, `viewer-host` in tools/lint-rules.ts). A link only: nothing in this repository fetches from these hosts, and lint fails any script that names one (FLR-REQ-106). Adding a host is the maintainers' decision, in a pull request of its own.

viewers.note: ICC Digital Codes: the free read-only view of the I-Codes
NFPA free access: the read-only view of NFPA codes and standards
IAPMO's free read-only view of its codes
